**AME – Adaptive Mix Exchange 1.1.0** · built by **Batze the bit builder** · *Every track finds its aim.*

A networked, adaptive channel strip (VST3, Windows x64). Put AME on your tracks (**Line**) and one instance on the master bus (**Exchange**): the Exchange listens to all lines, detects masking and gives every track its place in the spectrum and in the level balance – continuously.

### What's new in 1.1.0
- **Landscape window** (base 1400 × 760 instead of 1100 × 960): fits 1080p screens, also with 125 % Windows scaling
- Line: ADAPTIVE now sits next to the EQ; Exchange: patchbay, VU and spectrogram in a right-hand column
- **Folding sections**: ADAPTIVE and spectrogram (Line), line list and DETAILS column (Exchange) – the space goes to the EQ or analyser; state is remembered

### Highlights
- Full channel strip per track: input, phase, HPF/LPF (12/24/48 dB), gate/expander, 4-band EQ (shelf/bell), compressor (knee, mix, SC-HPF, auto release), de-esser, saturation/exciter, width/pan, output, limiter/clipper
- Adaptive engine with 6 programs (Rock/Band, Pop, Electronic, Hip-Hop, Acoustic, Metal), roles, priority and response per track; only cuts, total level stays constant
- Auto role detection from track name and sound
- Exchange monitor: Full / No Engine / Raw with level match; Direct, Hold and Recording per track
- Factory presets per role, user presets, A/B compare
- Analyser, spectrogram, masking patchbay, VU meters; vintage UI in landscape format, foldable sections, scalable 50–200 %
- German/English interface, built-in manual (DE/EN)
- Instances find each other automatically, also across plug-in processes (shared-memory hub)

### Installation
1. Unzip and copy `AME Adaptive Mix Exchange.vst3` to `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\`.
2. Rescan plug-ins in your DAW. The vendor is **Batze the bit builder**.

Works in all common VST3 hosts on Windows 64-bit (e.g. Ableton Live, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig Studio, FL Studio); tested with Ableton Live.

The manual is inside the plug-in (**MANUAL** button) and in the `Manual` folder of the ZIP.

---

**Deutsch:** Vernetzter, adaptiver Channelstrip (VST3). AME auf die Spuren (**Line**), eine Instanz auf den Master (**Exchange**) – jede Spur bekommt ihren Platz im Mix. Installation wie oben, Handbuch im Plugin (**HANDBUCH**) und im ZIP.
